gloss: public stage; the spotlight; center stage

definitions.gloss: public stage; the spotlight; front stage of public life
definitions.explanation: The visible, public arena where important events take place or where a person is in the public eye. Often used figuratively for someone's public career or prominence.

examples.japanese: {表舞台|おもてぶたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: To stand on the public stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{裏方|うらかた}→裏方：15033_urakata⟧だった⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、ついに{表舞台|おもてぶたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: After years behind the scenes, he finally stepped into the spotlight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{再|ふたた}び→再び：03600_futatabi⟧{表舞台|おもてぶたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧くる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{予想|よそう}しなかった→予想する：06064_yosousuru⟧。
examples.english: No one expected the retired politician to return to the public stage.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{表|おもて}→表：01355_omote⟧ (front, surface, public) + ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧ (stage). The metaphor of a stage is central — the {表舞台|おもてぶたい} is where things are visible to the public, in contrast to the behind-the-scenes world.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表舞台|おもてぶたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (stand on the public stage)
- {表舞台|おもてぶたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (step into the spotlight)
- {表舞台|おもてぶたい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧ (disappear from the public eye)
- {表舞台|おもてぶたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧ (return to the spotlight)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{裏方|うらかた}→裏方：15033_urakata⟧ — behind the scenes (the opposite: those who work out of public view)
- ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧ — stage (literal or figurative, without the specific "public" nuance)
- {檜舞台|ひのきぶたい} — grand stage (the most prestigious stage, implies a big moment)
